focus_capacity.limits: Shortest-turn capacity is an optimistic length bound, not semantic recall. Eight turns are a cap, not a requirement. Non-fit does not prove an answer failure.

tests.command: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 uv run --no-project --with pytest python -m pytest --noconftest tests/test_focus_capacity.py tests/test_evidence_focus.py -q
tests.scope: Isolated pure diagnostic/focus tests; no full local suite or model-quality measurement
tests.environment_note: System python lacked pytest; plugin/global storage setup unavailable in isolated env. Pure tests ran with external plugins and product conftest disabled. Repository CI runs normal conftest.
